artist: Houkago Tea Time (Yui, Mio, Ritsu, Tsumugi)
lyricsSnippet: でもね、逢えたよ、すてきな天使に / But you know, we met a wonderful angel... Azu-nyan!
trivia: The legendary teardrop-inducing graduation farewell song written by the seniors for their beloved junior Azusa.

japaneseTitle: ギターと孤独と蒼い惑星
lyricsSnippet: 聞いて、私の声が響くまで！ / Listen to me, until my voice echoes across the stars!
trivia: Performed live at Starry in Episode 5 to pass the stage audition, turning Bocchi from an introvert into Kessoku Band's hero.
